name: Hiki Sagiri
source:
Hobbies: Daydreaming
Likes: Origami, accessories, sweets
Dislikes: People

A sickly girl who is always nervous. She is terrible at socializing and communicating with people, and often tends to hide herself behind her scarf. She feels sympathy towards [url=/c54699]Seita[/url] and his situation, and wants to become friends with him despite her own problems.
